notes: Four distinct movable-part episodes are visible. The two doors of the upper cabinet are counted separately; their closing actions both occur within the sparsely sampled interval from frame 552 to 560, so their individual off-frame ordering is approximate.
scene_description: A user surveys a narrow modern kitchen, opens and closes a food-storage drawer, separately opens and closes both doors of the upper cabinet above the stove, and then opens and closes a utensil drawer beside the stove.
